# #3127: Patch: Cloudflare's 404 boots the client's playable 404, with a tavern-styled fallback
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Follow-up to #3119 / #3124 (R3119000). Today two 404s exist:

- `main.tsx` `NotFound` (`apps/web/src/notfound/`): the playable one, with the glitched path, the lost card that speaks and three face-down ways out. It only shows on a client-side route miss, or where the dev server falls back to the app.
- `apps/web/public/404.html`: what Cloudflare actually serves, with a 404 status, for every path `_redirects` doesn't route (`wrangler.jsonc` `not_found_handling: "404-page"`, both environments). It is a standalone page with no script. Its fanned "4 0 4" cards are hand-drawn parchment rectangles with a big digit, nothing like a JackiOh card; that hand is the main thing to fix. The frame around it is plain brown with system and Palatino fonts.

Make Cloudflare's 404 the client itself, and keep a script-free page as its fallback, whose hand is three real JackiOh cards.

**1. The hand: three JackiOh cards whose mana costs read 4, 0, 4 (the main point).** Replace the hand-drawn rectangles with the game's own card face, the frame `cards/CardFace.tsx` draws (`.cf`, `.cf-scale`, the `.cost-gem`, the name banner and art window, styled by `cards/cards.css`):

| Card | Name | Mana cost |
|---|---|---|
| left | Error | 4 |
| middle | Not | 0 |
| right | Found | 4 |

- The 404 is read off the cost gems, so the gems are the only numbers on the cards. Draw them as Spells (no attack or health) with an empty rules box or none, and the procedural art `CardArt` draws for each name.
- They are placeholder cards: no card id from the catalog, no set mark, no rarity foil, nothing a player could mistake for a real card.
- Keep today's motion: deal in stacked, fan out (−15°, 0°, 15°), turn over from the brand's card back into the face, float; all still under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Render them, don't hand-draw them. The best way is at build time, rendering `CardFace` to static markup (react-dom/server) in `static-pages.ts`, so the frame can never drift from the game's. The page built from `index.html` already links the client's stylesheet, `cards.css` included. If rendering `CardFace` from the Vite plugin isn't workable, the markup must use `CardFace`'s own classes and structure, with a test that holds them to `CardFace`'s output.
- Put the same three cards on the client's `NotFound` only if it fits the one-screen rule; it is not required.

**2. `dist/404.html` is the app.** `apps/web/static-pages.ts` already writes app pages from the built `index.html` in `writeBundle` (`writeStaticPages`, `pageHtml`), and the client replaces them at startup. Have it also write `dist/404.html` from the same template:
- `<meta name="robots" content="noindex" />` and the title `Page not found · JackiOh` (`net/head.ts` `documentTitleFor`, as the client names its 404)
- no canonical link (privacy.test already holds "at nothing for a 404")
- the fallback below as its static body

Cloudflare still answers with a 404 status, the client starts, routes on `window.location.pathname` and draws `NotFound` with the real path. A missing `/assets/*.js` still gets a 404 status, so `docs/architecture.md` §4.1's reason for the 404 page still holds; update that paragraph to say what the 404 page now is.

**3. The rest of the fallback restyled from the app's own assets (still no script).** It is what shows without JavaScript, and while or if the bundle fails to start:
- the hand of three cards from 1
- the self-hosted Alegreya (display) and Inter (text) from `/fonts/` (`src/fonts.css` names the exact files)
- the stacked logo `/brand/jackioh-logo-stacked.svg` in place of the text "JackiOh"
- `auth/tavern.css`'s plank floor (`.tavern.shell-panel[data-shown="true"]`) and brass-studded board (`.panel--auth` and its `::before` studs)
- the app's button look for "Back to the start" (`href="/"`)

**Watch out:**
- The static pages' pattern hides `.static-body` until startup and shows it only in `<noscript>` (`static-pages.ts`, line ~352). For the 404 that would leave a blank page when JS runs but the bundle fails to load (a stale deploy, a blocked chunk). The fallback must be visible until the client actually replaces `#root`.
- Check that the gate (`main.tsx`) shows no wait or sign-in flash before `NotFound` on a cold load of an unknown path.
- `public/404.html` must not also ship and overwrite or conflict with the generated one: remove it, or make it the fallback's source and have the plugin fill it in, whichever is simpler.
- `_headers`' CSP must allow what the page loads (it is all same-origin).

Rulings: a new note in this issue's block saying the static 404 is now the client with a script-free fallback whose hand is three placeholder card faces (Error 4, Not 0, Found 4), superseding R3119000's "The static page" paragraph. Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.

### Acceptance

- The fallback's hand is three JackiOh card faces (`CardFace`'s frame and classes, `.cost-gem` included), named Error, Not and Found, whose cost gems read 4, 0 and 4, with no attack or health. A test reads the built `dist/404.html` and checks the three names and costs in that order, and that the markup is `CardFace`'s (rendered from it, or held to its output).
- The hand deals in, fans and turns over as today's does, and lies still and face up under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web build` writes `dist/404.html` from the built `index.html`: it loads the client's entry script, has `noindex`, the 404 title and no canonical link, and holds the fallback (the hand, logo, fonts, plank floor, board, `href="/"`). Tested in `static-pages.test.ts` and `net/check-production-bundle.test.ts`, with the new ruling's id in the test names.
- The fallback is visible with JavaScript off, and when the entry script fails to load; the client replaces it once it starts. A test proves both.
- `net/cloudflare-serve.test.ts`'s "no script" test changes to fit (the 404 page now carries the client), and `cloudflare-config.test.ts` still holds `404-page` in both environments.
- An e2e spec (or an existing one: 14, 46 or 47) loads an unrouted path from a built client, sees `not-found` with the path, the lost card and the ways out, and checks that `not-found-home` leads home.
- The fallback page fits one screen at 1280x720 and 390x844 (R1581000) and its link meets `--hit-min` (R2122000).
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes; `docs/architecture.md` §4.1 and `apps/web/README.md`'s 404 paragraph describe the new setup.

Follows #3119 (merged in #3124).
